regions.merged_text: The following letter from my eldest sister, Mrs. Ella (Casey) Traynor, who taught me my ABCs and next to dear Mother my prayers, describes dear Father's last struggles and beautiful death. The writer herself has since passed away, having been burried Christmas Eve 1928. May their dear souls rest in the peace of the saints!
